title.en: NVIDIA Reaches Agreement to Acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 Billion
title.zhHans: NVIDIA 达成以 129.3 亿美元收购 Hugging Face 的协议

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA announced an agreement on September 3, 2026 to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion and pledged continued model, hardware, and cloud choice; the transaction had not closed.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日宣布达成以 129.3 亿美元收购 Hugging Face 的协议，并承诺继续支持模型、硬件与云服务选择；交易尚未完成交割。

summary.en: NVIDIA announced an agreement to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion on September 3, 2026. NVIDIA says Hugging Face will remain open, support models and accelerators across the ecosystem, and not require NVIDIA compute for building or deploying through the platform. The announcement is an agreement rather than completed ownership, so platform-control and competition effects remain prospective.
summary.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日宣布达成以 129.3 亿美元收购 Hugging Face 的协议。NVIDIA 称 Hugging Face 将保持开放，支持生态中的模型与加速器，并且在该平台构建或部署不要求使用 NVIDIA 算力。该公告代表协议而非已完成的所有权转移，因此平台控制与竞争影响仍属前瞻性。

narrative.en: NVIDIA says Hugging Face serves more than 18 million developers and hosts more than 3 million models, 500,000 datasets, and 1 million applications. WIRED describes the deal as a strategic software-side move and reports NVIDIA's commitment to current open standards. The available sources establish the announced agreement and NVIDIA's pledges; they do not establish a completed consolidation, an outcome of regulatory review, or a historical superlative for the transaction. EpochArc marks it as a provisional L2 commercial-power signal and records community-neutrality questions as unresolved.
narrative.zhHans: NVIDIA 称 Hugging Face 服务逾 1,800 万开发者，托管逾 300 万个模型、50 万个数据集和 100 万个应用。WIRED 将该交易描述为向软件端拓展的战略行动，并报道 NVIDIA 对维持现有开放标准的承诺。现有来源确立的是已公告协议及 NVIDIA 的承诺；并不能证明已经完成整合、监管审查结果或该交易的历史最高地位。EpochArc 将其标记为暂定 L2 的商业权力信号，并将社区中立性问题记录为未决。

description.en: If the agreement closes, it would place a major open-model platform within NVIDIA's corporate group; the scale and competitive effects are not yet realized.
description.zhHans: 若协议完成交割，该交易将使一个主要开放模型平台进入 NVIDIA 企业集团；其规模与竞争影响尚未实现。

description.en: The announced agreement raises unresolved questions about future platform neutrality and competition, rather than proving a completed change in control.
description.zhHans: 已公告协议引发对未来平台中立性与竞争的未决问题，而非证明控制权已经完成变更。

text.en: NVIDIA announced an agreement on September 3, 2026 to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion; the deal had not yet closed.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日宣布达成以 129.3 亿美元收购 Hugging Face 的协议；交易尚未完成交割。

text.en: NVIDIA pledged that Hugging Face would remain open and continue supporting model, cloud, and accelerator choice; this is a company commitment rather than an independently tested post-close outcome.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 承诺 Hugging Face 将保持开放并继续支持模型、云和加速器选择；这是公司承诺，而非经独立检验的交割后结果。

text.en: The announcement is an acquisition agreement, not completed ownership; closing, regulatory review, and long-term platform-neutrality effects remain unresolved.
text.zhHans: 该公告是收购协议，而非已完成的所有权转移；交割、监管审查与长期平台中立性影响仍未确定。

editorial.reviewNotes: Reviewed as an announced, unclosed agreement; deleted unsupported transaction-rank and completed-consolidation language.
